title: Updating the N1 register
statement: For any register record $R$ and natural number $v$, changing the value at index $5$ in the $21$-entry sequence of register values of $R$ to $v$ gives the sequence of register values of the record obtained by replacing $R$'s $N1$ register with $v$.
